[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.nat.basic

def implementation (arr: List Int) : List String :=
  let filtered := arr.filter (fun x => 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9);
  let sorted_filtered := List.sort (fun x y => x ≤ y) filtered;
  let mapped := List.map (fun x => digits[x-1]) sorted_filtered;
  let reversed := mapped.reverse;
  let result := List.zipWith (fun x y => y!x) (List.range (sorted_filtered.length)) reversed;
  result
where
  digits := ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma idx_of_in_range
(i: Nat)
(d: List String)
: i < d.length → (d[i] : String) ∈ d :=
by
  unfold List.idxOf
  linarith

lemma map_sorted_reverse
(f: Int → Int)
(arr: List Int)
: List.Sorted (Int.le) (List.map f (List.sort (fun x y => x ≤ y) arr)) →
List.Sorted (Int.le) (List.map f arr) :=
by
  intros h_sorted
  induction arr generalizing f
